subject: We want to hear from you!

messages.author: b957975f29ba9e83
messages.subject: We want to hear from you!
parts:
Hi all, 

We want to get a sense from the D-RUG community about how to structure our sessions this year. Are there certain mini-workshops that would be super helpful to you? Do you want us to maximize time to answer your questions about R? Please take this (very short) survey to share your thoughts! 

Thanks so much,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
